headline: Indonesian National Police Reaffirm Jokowi Diploma Authenticity
seoTitle: Polri Reaffirms Authenticity of Jokowi Diploma
metaDescription: The Indonesian National Police maintain that the authenticity of Jokowi's diploma has been verified by forensic experts, declining requests for re-testing.
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police stated that the diploma has already undergone procedural forensic examinations.
Authorities declined requests from figures including Refly Harun and Roy Suryo to subject the document to further testing.
Police officials concluded that there is no requirement to conduct additional verification of the diploma's validity.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian National Police have officially addressed ongoing public and political scrutiny regarding the academic credentials of the president. In response to requests for re-verification—including those put forward by public figures Refly Harun and Roy Suryo—the police maintained that the matter is closed. According to official statements from the institution, the diploma had already been subjected to rigorous procedural testing by the Forensic Laboratory Center (Puslabfor). Based on these forensic examinations, officials asserted that the document is authentic and there is no necessity to repeat the testing process. This declaration serves as the police's definitive stance in response to persistent allegations questioning the legitimacy of the president's educational documentation, effectively dismissing calls for further investigation into the matter.
whyItIsViral: The topic maintains visibility through coverage by five independent media outlets and consistent reporting on the police's final stance regarding the diploma.
